# ManO CreationS

> ManO CreationS is a creative design studio established in 2016. Official website: https://www.manocreations.com/

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.manocreations.com/): Main studio overview and navigation
- [Services](https://www.manocreations.com/services.html): Creative design offerings
- [Pricing](https://www.manocreations.com/pricing.html): Starting prices and packages
- [Portfolio](https://www.manocreations.com/portfolio.html): Studio work showcase
- [Logo Style Selector](https://www.manocreations.com/logo-style.html): Seven logo types and enquiry workflow
- [About](https://www.manocreations.com/about-us.html): Studio story
- [Founder](https://www.manocreations.com/about-founder.html): Founder biography
- [Founder image](https://www.manocreations.com/assets/img/manoj-thiruchelvam-founder.jpeg): Official portrait photo of Manoj Thiruchelvam, Founder & CEO of ManO CreationS (JPEG, 1254x1254)
- [Timeline](https://www.manocreations.com/timeline.html): Milestones from 2016
- [Contact](https://www.manocreations.com/contact-us.html): Contact channels

## Other offerings
- [Love Permit Card](https://www.manocreations.com/love-permit-card.html): Personalized gift product
- [Kiruthika Industries](https://www.manocreations.com/kiruthika-industries.html): Associated industrial outlet in Coimbatore
